incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — auth.probe.high_rate detected on edge-proxy-2 (eu-west-1). Unusual token reuse + spike in 401s. Alert: https://internal/alerts/1767890123
sre-oncall: I'm on it. paging @sec-oncall and grabbing live logs.
sec-oncall: ack. initial triage: repeated bearer tokens across multiple user IDs. possible token scrape or leaked log shard.
alice_nguyen: pulling auth logs now, filtering: `jq -r '.events[] | select(.event=="auth" and .status==401)'`
mike_j: quick grep shows same token fingerprint used against multiple services from IP 34.122.11.9 — started ~2026-03-17T02:04Z.
carol_prod: customer-impact: ~7 customers reported elevated 401s for service-to-service calls. No successful unauthorized access seen so far.
sec-oncall: plan: 1) hot-rotate long-lived service tokens for svc-metrics and svc-ingest, 2) pause external log shipping to thirdparty-forwarder-01, 3) preserve evidence.
sre-oncall: initiating rotation for svc-metrics now: `tools/key-rotate --service svc-metrics --mode hot-swap` — will coordinate with @deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: starting canary rotation job job-4522 -> targets: edge-proxy-2, edge-proxy-3.
alice_nguyen: pausing log forwarder to third party: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment/log-forwarder --replicas=0`
mike_j: dumping KV cache for edge-proxy-2: `rdctl dump-kvcache --shard edge-2 > /tmp/kvcache.dump` — preserving for forensics.
sec-oncall: preserve timeline + upload to secure case CASE-2026-0317. DO NOT paste dumps in public channels.
carol_prod: drafting customer note: "We detected suspicious token-reuse attempts targeting service endpoints. We rotated service tokens and blocked the source IP. No customer data accessed." Sending to legal for review.
sre-oncall: svc-metrics and svc-ingest rotation completed. deploy-bot reports canary OK.
deploy-bot: rotation finished: job-4522 success. rollout id r-20260317-4522.
sec-oncall: verification: old tokens now reject on introspect endpoint. Example: `curl -s -X POST https://auth.introspect -d 'token=OLD'` -> 401.
alice_nguyen: re-enable log-forwarder in buffered mode so we can replay into internal queue only: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment/log-forwarder --replicas=1 && export FORWARD_MODE=buffered`
mike_j: evidence uploaded to CASE-2026-0317 and s3://secure-evidence/CASE-2026-0317/kvcache.dump (kms: redwood-prod).
sec-oncall: next actions assigned: 1) rotate any remaining long-lived tokens from runbook, 2) full audit of log-shipping configs and RBAC, 3) IDS rule to block 34.122.11.9 and similar clusters, 4) customer outreach & legal signoff.
sre-oncall: oncall handoff in ~60m to @night-sre. I'll prepare a short runbook note with commands executed and current monitoring windows.
night-sre: I will take over in 1h, monitor auth.probe.high_rate alerts, confirm IP blocks, and follow up on runbook tasks.
sre-oncall: incident severity set P2 -> mitigated. No confirmed exfil of customer data. CASE ID: CASE-2026-0317. Re-enable normal alerting thresholds in 24h and run postmortem if timelines/controls require it.
